coverage.ballots_note: Verified selected appointment ballots and the 2018 incumbent check. Earlier ballots are not digitized here; no no-confidence motions are included. No claim of exhaustive coverage after 2022.
coverage.context_note: Issue and government-period pairs require delivered party counts. Historical session pairs use the existing mart. Abstention is a comparable position; tied, absent-only and missing positions are excluded. Mixed counts with a unique plurality retain that position.
coverage.government_note: Agreement names are seed-level term context, not dated proof of support. Session-start government labels are not used for vote-date joins.
